references.text: A man from each tribe was to represent the people, the same principle as here with a thousand from each tribe.
The fulfillment of the command to send a thousand from each tribe to war against the Midianites.
The same organizational principle with one man from each tribe at the Jordan River.
The tribal leaders gather when the trumpets sound, showing Israel's organization by tribes.
The counting of all men fit for battle in Israel, the basis for sending a thousand from each tribe.
